name: SolidCraft (open-source parametric 3D CAD)
summary: Parametric 3D CAD app written in pure Rust: sketch, constrain and build solids on a feature timeline that rebuilds when a dimension changes. Runs as a desktop app, in the browser, or driven by AI agents through a built-in MCP server. Ships near-daily releases (v0.29.0 on Nov 1, 2026).

access.notes: Dual-licensed MIT or Apache-2.0 at your option; third-party code and assets keep their own licenses (see THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES). Results must be checked by a qualified person per DISCLAIMER.

procedure: Open solidcraft.io/download and pick the installer for Windows, macOS or Linux (AppImage, deb, rpm, flatpak, snap), or grab it from GitHub Releases.
Or try it with no install at solidcraft.io/app in the browser.
For agent use, enable the built-in MCP server (see docs.solidcraft.io).

stats.cadence: near-daily releases (v0.27.1 to v0.29.0 between Oct 30 and Nov 1, 2026)

verdict.why: Real, actively released open-source CAD with permissive dual license, desktop + browser builds and MCP for agents; early-stage but very active (12.7k stars in under a month).
